summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass: 40 passed, run with the shared venv Python. Nothing was committed. Choices: an explicit isinstance(Node) guard so None is not treated as a wildcard; type-ignore comments placed on the parser call lines inside pytest.raises blocks. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-checking and formatting were checked by reading only. Line lengths are within 88 columns.
